posts.title: A shell exclamation mark is not for yelling. Be lazy.
posts.description: Event designators have been hiding in not-so-plain-sight since the late 1970s — so powerful that forgetting might be part of a massive conspiracy to wear out developer keyboards faster than otherwise.

posts.title: A shell colon does nothing. Use it anyway.
posts.description: I've written more shell scripts than I can count, but I still stumble upon tricks that honestly blow my mind far too often than I care to admit. Latest thing that blew my head clean off? The shell colon.

posts.title: Why I stopped proofreading and started to listen
posts.description: Proofreading is annoying and error-prone. Listening to your writing catches those mistakes which your brain and eyes are trying their very best to keep hidden.
